# Motor Diagnostics: MSP and Blackbox comparison across candidate Betaflight tags

**Generated by** `scripts/motor-msp-compare.mjs` (Phase 1, read-only; it downloads public source and sends nothing to any aircraft). **Backlog:** [section 19](backlogs/in-progress/UAV_COMPANION_AUTOMATED_MOTOR_DIAGNOSTICS_BACKLOG.md).

Labels: **VERIFIED-SOURCE** = extracted from the tagged source text (not run on hardware); **HARDWARE-DEPENDENT** = depends on target or board; **UNRESOLVED** = not settled by this script. Extraction is textual and a person still reads the cited code before a row is promoted.

Tags: 4.3.2, 4.4.3, 4.5.5, 2025.12.5, 2026.6.2. Candidates only: 4.5.5, 2025.12.5, 2026.6.2. 4.3.2 and 4.4.3 are compared as unsupported references. Reference master `09b90997` is not part of this run unless listed.

## Key findings (computed)

| Tag | API | GYRO bit | MOTOR bit | RPM bit | GYROUNFILT bit | Mask in `MSP_BLACKBOX_CONFIG` | Dedicated gyroUnfilt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4.3.2 | 1.44 | 7 | 10 | - | - | no | no |
| 4.4.3 | 1.45 | 7 | 10 | - | - | yes | no |
| 4.5.5 | 1.46 | 7 | 10 | 12 | 13 | yes | yes |
| 2025.12.5 | 1.47 | 7 | 11 | 13 | 14 | yes | yes |
| 2026.6.2 | 1.48 | 7 | 11 | 13 | 14 | yes | yes |

- **Mask bit positions differ between tags** (4.5.5 versus 2025.12.5 and later); a single fixed bit number is wrong for at least one candidate.
- **`MSP_FC_VERSION` changes meaning:** 4.3.2: FC_VERSION_MAJOR ; FC_VERSION_MINOR ; FC_VERSION_PATCH_LEVEL | 4.4.3: FC_VERSION_MAJOR ; FC_VERSION_MINOR ; FC_VERSION_PATCH_LEVEL | 4.5.5: FC_VERSION_MAJOR ; FC_VERSION_MINOR ; FC_VERSION_PATCH_LEVEL | 2025.12.5: (uint8_t)(FC_VERSION_YEAR-FC_CALVER_BASE_YEAR) ; FC_VERSION_MONTH ; FC_VERSION_PATCH_LEVEL ; FC_VERSION_STRING | 2026.6.2: (uint8_t)(FC_VERSION_YEAR-FC_CALVER_BASE_YEAR) ; FC_VERSION_MONTH ; FC_VERSION_PATCH_LEVEL ; FC_VERSION_STRING. From API 1.47 the three bytes are year minus 2000, month, patch, then a length-prefixed version string.
- Layout differences by byte count are in section 3; field expressions that were renamed or replaced with a constant (for example `minthrottle` replaced by 0 in `MSP_MOTOR_CONFIG` from 2025.12.5) are visible in section 2 even where the byte count is unchanged.

## 4. Blackbox configuration, field mask and mode

| Item | 4.3.2 | 4.4.3 | 4.5.5 | 2025.12.5 | 2026.6.2 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields_disabled_mask` in `MSP_BLACKBOX_CONFIG` reply | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST` used in blackbox.c | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Dedicated `gyroUnfilt` in blackbox.c | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| CLI `blackbox_mode` setting present | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| CLI value table | `"NORMAL", "MOTOR_TEST", "ALWAYS"` | `"NORMAL", "MOTOR_TEST", "ALWAYS"` | `"NORMAL", "MOTOR_TEST", "ALWAYS"` | `"NORMAL", "MOTOR_TEST", "ALWAYS"` | `"NORMAL", "MOTOR_TEST", "ALWAYS"` |
| Internal mode enum | BLACKBOX_MODE_NORMAL=0, BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST=1, BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON=2 | BLACKBOX_MODE_NORMAL=0, BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST=1, BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON=2 | BLACKBOX_MODE_NORMAL=0, BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST=1, BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON=2 | BLACKBOX_MODE_NORMAL=0, BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST=1, BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON=2 | BLACKBOX_MODE_NORMAL=0, BLACKBOX_MODE_MOTOR_TEST=1, BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON=2 |

The internal enum name `BLACKBOX_MODE_ALWAYS_ON` appears only as a source identifier. The app accepts the CLI tokens `NORMAL`, `MOTOR_TEST`, `ALWAYS` and never `ALWAYS_ON`.

Bit semantics (set = disabled, tested as "fields_disabled_mask & (1 << field)" in blackbox.c): 4.3.2=yes, 4.4.3=yes, 4.5.5=yes, 2025.12.5=yes, 2026.6.2=yes. The bit position of a field is its enum index in the table above **for that tag**. Positions differ between tags (RPM and GYROUNFILT move when fields are inserted), so the readiness code must use the per-tag table in `src/preflight/versions.js`, never one fixed number.

## 6. Arm state and motor-stop semantics

| Item | 4.3.2 | 4.4.3 | 4.5.5 | 2025.12.5 | 2026.6.2 | Label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PERMANENT_ID_BOXARM` | UNRESOLVED | UNRESOLVED | UNRESOLVED | UNRESOLVED | UNRESOLVED | VERIFIED-SOURCE (id only) |
| `MSP_SET_MOTOR` writes `motor_disarmed` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | VERIFIED-SOURCE |

The bit index of ARM inside the flight-mode flags of `MSP_STATUS_EX` depends on which boxes are active on the board, so it must be mapped at runtime with `MSP_BOXIDS` plus the status flags: **HARDWARE-DEPENDENT**. The readiness gate does not rely on a fixed bit.

## 7. Hardware-dependent and unresolved facts (not settled by source)

| Fact | Label | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `USE_DSHOT_TELEMETRY_STATS` compiled in, so `invalidPct` is real | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | Per target; `#undef` count in `common_post.h`: 4.3.2=1, 4.4.3=1, 4.5.5=1, 2025.12.5=1, 2026.6.2=1. A board may still lack it. |
| Actual API minor reported by a flashed build | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | A build may differ from its tag if the constant was bumped later. |
| Bidirectional DShot actually working | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | The flag is a hint; only live RPM proves it. |
| Mixer and custom motor order | UNRESOLVED | No mixer-read message confirmed. |
| `ARM_SWITCH` arming-disable bit and the arm-switch position | UNRESOLVED | Not read by this script and not used by the gate: the switch position is attested by the user (backlog section 3). |
| Value scale of `rpm` in `MSP_MOTOR_TELEMETRY` (electrical versus mechanical) | UNRESOLVED | Needs a fixture or powered telemetry; not used in Phases 1 and 2. |
| Whether `blackbox_mode` can be read safely | UNRESOLVED | CLI only; RQ-1 is not permitted in Phases 1-2. |
| `MSP_ANALOG` voltage scale and presence of a battery divider | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | Board specific (measurement M3). |
| Dataflash size and free space | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | Per board (measurement M7). |
| Android phone behaviour | HARDWARE-DEPENDENT | See the Android spike notes. |
